name: SnipeShield
description: Fair token launches on X Layer. A public TapeOut NAND circuit sets the launch tax per trade: snipers pay up to 25%, everyone else 1%, and nobody can raise it.

beforeYouTrade.summary: Call quoteBuy or quoteSell with your own address. They are free view calls that return the exact tier and tax the contract will charge.
beforeYouTrade.quoteBuy: function quoteBuy(address trader, uint256 okbIn) view returns (uint256 tokensOut, uint8 signals, uint8 tier, uint256 taxBps)
beforeYouTrade.quoteSell: function quoteSell(address trader, uint256 tokensIn) view returns (uint256 okbOut, uint8 signals, uint8 tier, uint256 taxBps)
signalBits: recent (you traded in the last 60 blocks)
beforeYouTrade.advice: To pay the base 1%, wait 5 blocks after launch, keep size under 0.5% of supply, avoid crowded blocks and space your trades a minute apart.
